summary: Six blocking defects affect run selection, data preservation, or design evidence. A 100-file sandbox drop completed in 0.339 seconds.

findings.summary: Drop can select an inherited run instead of the current worktree's run.
findings.evidence: The filter matches where a state copy was found, not the worktree recorded by that state or the checked-out branch, then takes matches[0]. In a sandbox containing the current 011-drop run and an inherited 001-old state whose original worktree no longer exists, drop successfully removed 001-old and returned its PR URL. This violates FR-001 and FR-002. ENG-1 and ENG-26: no test asserts selection with multiple state copies.
findings.fix: Select the authoritative run for the current worktree and branch, refusing ambiguity; add a regression test with an inherited orphaned run.

findings.summary: Rollback destroys pre-existing tracked changes when git refuses removal.
findings.evidence: After git rm rejects a locally modified run file, rollback resets the index and checks out the entire folder from HEAD, then deletes the archive. Violates SC-003 and ENG-26; the commit-failure test covers only a clean worktree (ENG-1).
findings.fix: Refuse before mutation when affected paths have staged or unstaged changes, or snapshot and restore their exact index and working-tree state; test both cases.

findings.summary: Archive silently excludes every nested file named lock.json.
findings.evidence: shutil.ignore_patterns and dircmp's ignore list apply at every depth, although FR-003 and SC-002 exclude only the run's transient root lock. ENG-1 and ENG-26: no test asserts preservation of a nested namesake.
findings.fix: Exclude only the root run lock from copying and verification; add a nested lock.json preservation test.

findings.summary: Drop commits unrelated, uncommitted design-map edits.
findings.evidence: The command reads the working-tree map, rewrites it, then stages the whole file. An unrelated unstaged map value changed from 1 to 999 was included in the drop commit. FR-006 and FR-017 limit the drop to the evidence move and reference rewrite.
findings.fix: Refuse a dirty map before modifying it, or preserve its index and working-tree changes while committing only the intended rewrite; test staged and unstaged edits.

findings.summary: Moving evidence leaves repository-relative paths inside evidence metadata dangling.
findings.evidence: design-code-mapping.md sections 1 and 4 require context and comparison metadata to retain repository-relative paths. Drop moves those files but rewrites only the canonical map; comparison.json still referenced specs/011-drop/factory/design/ref.png after success.
findings.fix: Reconcile the relocation contract with the mapping requirement, update affected evidence references or retain valid paths, and test that retained metadata references resolve after drop.

findings.summary: Existing canonical maps outside the hard-coded path retain broken evidence references.
findings.evidence: design-code-mapping.md section 3 extends an existing canonical map and stores its path in state.design.map, but drop always edits docs/design-code-map.json.
findings.fix: Resolve the authoritative map from run state or migrate it explicitly, and add a regression test for an alternate map.
